name: German Bund 10Y
notes: Eurozone risk-free benchmark.

name: US Treasury 10Y

name: VIX (equity volatility)
notes: The fear gauge; spikes on every risk-off event.

name: Sovereign CDS (EM / periphery)
notes: Default-risk gauge (Russia 2022, Italy, EM).

name: Baltic Dry Index
notes: Dry-bulk freight; China-demand & disruption gauge.

name: EUR/USD
notes: The euro in dollars; 58% of the dollar index, so mostly its mirror. Yahoo's daily close is the price at 00:00 London of the bar's day.

name: Nasdaq Composite

name: US Treasury 5Y
notes: The front end of the curve; measured as yield in bps like the 10-year.
